protocol.tuning: 50% of calibration questions; tables built only on this half
protocol.heldout: other 50% of calibration questions; selected rule applied without refitting
protocol.selection: one-standard-error rule on the tuning half: among variants within one SE of the best tuning net, take the fewest calls; the deployed rule wins ties and is frozen unless the best tuning net beats it by its own SE
protocol.h1: hard-calibrated table beats deployed table on hard held-out links
protocol.h2: lower confidence or shrinkage beats deployed rule on held-out links
protocol.h3: different bin count or smoothing beats deployed rule on held-out links
protocol.caveat: offline calibration-link evaluation; crawl-level confirmation requires the judge backend
